A_explicit_tool_not_scheduled.description: User explicitly named list_recent_brain_changes but planner did not detect or schedule it. Instead fell back to semantic_retrieve + repo_status_read.
A_explicit_tool_not_scheduled.root_cause: planner.py classify_goal() had no explicit tool name detection. Only keyword-based classification (e.g., 'patch', 'diff', 'memory'). Tool names like 'list_recent_brain_changes' were invisible to the planner.
A_explicit_tool_not_scheduled.fix: Added EXPLICIT_TOOL_PATTERNS regex mapping and _detect_explicit_tool_requests() function. Added _build_explicit_tool_plan() to schedule named tools directly.

B_autonomy_diagnostic_not_scheduled.description: User described autonomy symptoms (heartbeat stale, verify process) but planner fell back to semantic_retrieve + repo_status_read without scheduling diagnostic tools.
B_autonomy_diagnostic_not_scheduled.root_cause: No diagnostic phrase mapping in planner. Phrases like 'heartbeat stale', 'verify autonomy' were invisible to keyword-based classification.
B_autonomy_diagnostic_not_scheduled.fix: Added DIAGNOSTIC_PHRASES mapping with autonomy_heartbeat, recent_changes, git_history triggers. Mapped to safe tool equivalents.

C_kernel_changes_not_scheduled.description: User asked about recent kernel changes in Spanish ('cuales fueron los ultimos cambios en el kernel del agente?'). Planner classified as general_reasoning and only scheduled semantic_retrieve.
C_kernel_changes_not_scheduled.root_cause: Spanish phrases 'ultimos cambios', 'cambios en el kernel' not matched by English-only keyword classification. No recent-changes classification existed.
C_kernel_changes_not_scheduled.fix: Added recent_changes_diagnosis classification. Added Spanish triggers to DIAGNOSTIC_PHRASES.

D_safe_patch_dry_run_misclassification.description: Prompt 'Solicitar al planner que programe list_recent_brain_changes...' was classified as safe_patch_dry_run because 'patch' appeared in the goal text.
D_safe_patch_dry_run_misclassification.root_cause: classify_goal() checked for 'patch'/'diff' before checking for explicit tool scheduling intent.
D_safe_patch_dry_run_misclassification.fix: Added guard: only classify as safe_patch_dry_run if patch/diff keywords exist AND no explicit tool scheduling words (programa, solicita, schedule, tool principal).

list_recent_brain_changes.resolution: Mapped to repo_history_read + repo_status_read + grep_search as safe equivalent

get_live_autonomy_status.resolution: Mapped to route_probe probing autonomy endpoint

check_service_status.resolution: Mapped to route_probe to health endpoint

get_autonomy_phase.resolution: Mapped to semantic_retrieve about autonomy phase
